svg.text: Research012 | Exact symmetry does not guarantee correct moves

C Frozen canonicalizing wrapper: 4,520 /4,520 correct complete legal sets.
Intersection cannot add false members; union cannot omit optimal members. Neither control proves exactness.
Mean uses exact sum>=0; no rounding of a small negative mean to zero. Scores are NOT probabilities.
These aggregations are fixed postprocessing, not learned symmetry or a deployed replacement.
